-- @name open_orders
-- @description Open orders for a customer
-- @param CustomerId int required
-- @returns OrderId int, Total decimal(18,2)
SELECT OrderId, Total FROM dbo.Orders WHERE CustomerId = @CustomerId

-- @name open_orders
-- @description All open orders
-- @returns OrderId int, Total decimal(18,2)
SELECT OrderId, Total FROM dbo.Orders

-- @name open_orders
-- @description Open orders for a customer
-- @param CustomerId int required
-- @param Status nvarchar(20) optional default=Open
-- @param Limit int optional default=100
-- @param Since date optional default=2026-01-01
-- @returns OrderId int, Total decimal(18,2)
SELECT OrderId, Total FROM dbo.Orders
WHERE CustomerId = @CustomerId AND Status = @Status AND Since <= @Since AND OrderId <= @Limit
ORDER BY OrderId

-- @name open_orders

-- @name open_orders
-- @description Open orders for a customer
-- @param CustomerId int required
-- @returns OrderId int, Total decimal(18,2)
-- a trailing comment inside the body is fine
WITH cte AS (
  SELECT OrderId, Total FROM dbo.Orders WHERE CustomerId = @CustomerId
)
SELECT OrderId, Total FROM cte; -- trailing semicolon

-- @name open_orders
-- @description Type matrix
-- @param A int required
-- @param B bigint required
-- @param C bit required
-- @param D decimal(18,2) required
-- @param E nvarchar(50) required
-- @param F nvarchar(max) required
-- @param G varchar(max) required
-- @param H date required
-- @param I datetime2 required
-- @param J uniqueidentifier required
-- @param K NVARCHAR(MAX) required
-- @returns OrderId int, Total decimal(18,2)
SELECT OrderId, Total FROM dbo.Orders
WHERE OrderId = @A AND OrderId = @B AND OrderId = @C AND OrderId = @D
  AND OrderId = @E AND OrderId = @F AND OrderId = @G AND OrderId = @H
  AND OrderId = @I AND OrderId = @J AND OrderId = @K
